None is more unjust than those who stop Allah's name being mentioned in His mosques and seek their ruin, facing disgrace in this world and great punishment in the Hereafter.
No one is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies His verses, and the wrongdoers will not succeed.
No one is more unjust than one who falsely claims revelation; at death the angels demand the wrongdoers' souls, and they come to Allah alone, without their claimed intercessors.
Every city has its greatest criminals conspiring, but only against themselves; they demand what the messengers were given and will suffer debasement and severe punishment.
Those who invent lies about Allah and avert people from His way will be presented before their Lord, cursed, their punishment multiplied, and in the Hereafter the greatest losers.
Those who plan evil deeds should not feel safe from the earth swallowing them or punishment seizing them suddenly or gradually, yet your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
Allah defers punishment for wrongdoing to a fixed term; those attributing to Him what they dislike will have the Fire, and Satan, who beautified earlier nations' deeds, is their ally.
One shielding himself with his face from the worst punishment on Resurrection Day is not like the secure, and wrongdoers are told to taste what they earned.
Wrongdoers would give the whole earth and as much again to ransom themselves on Resurrection Day, as the unexpected and the evils they earned appear before them.
Those Allah sends astray have no protector; the wrongdoers will ask to return, be exposed to the Fire in humiliation, and the believers will call them the true losers.
The wrongdoers will have a portion of punishment like their predecessors', so let them not hasten it; woe to the disbelievers from their promised Day.
Even seeing part of the sky fall, they would call it heaped clouds; so leave them to their Day, when their plan fails, and the wrongdoers face punishment before that.
